Ten rows a page, as drawn (it was 25). Frame 1101's 8-tall #001615 track with a 4-tall #123f3c thumb is drawn as the scroll container's own scrollbar. Frame 271 is the 52 pager, always present, range computed. A cap standing in for a supply is a near-neighbour quantity under the heading's name, so the constant and formatPct came out and the cell is a dash naming the missing read. SHARED FIX, measured on the component's own cited board: ExplorerTablePager drew its page chip on #122524, the strip's own fill, so the chip had no visible fill on every explorer page; 11998:244882 (Blocks) and both instances here draw #001615 with Mulish 14/16, the group Frame 988 at opacity 64, and the range in Mulish 12/14 - all four now match (6b174556d, ExplorerTablePager.board.test.ts). OVERTURNS PART OF THIS LANE'S OWN WAVE 59 ROW, found while building the Launchpad tiles this pass. That row closed the board done and its source comment says the six tile figures are Mulish Light 24/28 -0.96, which is what the board draws (the tile row Frame 631 11998:260426, read with get_design_context in wave 59). The code set them in font-mono, and in this preset font-mono is NOT Mulish: modules/skai-ui/src/lib/design-tokens.ts:349 maps mono to JetBrains Mono, Menlo, monospace, while mulish (:357) is Mulish, and tailwind.config.ts adds no override. So every tile figure rendered in a different face while the comment and the row both said Mulish - the class read as the right thing and was not. FIXED at LendingPage.tsx:252 and :259 (the unavailable dash and the figure) to font-mulish, which is what AnalyticsPage, TokenListPage and GasTrackerPage already use for the same run. Swept the directory for the shape rather than trusting the two hits: font-mono text-2xl font-light appears nowhere else in src/pages/explorer, and the new tileValueFace.test.ts checks every page in the directory (27 green) so a new page cannot repeat it unseen. Every other figure the wave 59 row states is untouched and stands on that read. Commit 8a01a5a7b on main, not pushed - Ruling 16.
